reviews.comment: His lectures were very interesting! I loved the material and left this class with a newfound love for Arthurian lit. Essays and exams are very easy and the final is open-note.

Prof Peterson is such a funny guy! He loves to make his lectures super engaging with the class and I would definitely take him again. 4 writing assignments, one of the first 3 will need to be revised where you meet with him in person (he has very flexible office hours). Short, easy, daily in class assignments start around a month into the semester
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Peterson is a very nice and funny guy and his lecture material has been pretty fun to read about. 4 writing assignments, one of the first three which he requires you to revise unless told otherwise. Around the second month is when he starts implementing daily in class assignments, but they're all short questions about what you've read.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Peterson's 330 class was great. He's a great lecturer and is pretty funny. Just an all around goofy dude. Quizzes were pretty easy as long as you know the general stories they're over, and the exams were super simple. Mostly repurposed quiz questions. Attend class, read the stories or just get a summary, and you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Would def recommend this for a literature credit. Attendance is mandatory, but he is a really funny and engaging lecturer so it's not too bad. Weekly open book quizzes and two open note exams, but it's easy to find all the material necessary. He is also understanding if you have to miss class here or there. Great guy, would definitely take again!

Arthurian literature-- read before class 2x a week (or not i guess) and one reading quiz per week that are super easy. Exams are online at home and open note/book. I feel guilty when I don't pay attention in class, that's how great of a teacher he is. So funny and engaging. Such an underrated class

I've never written one of these but I had to for this guy. I want him to adopt me he's actually so funny. If you need an english 300 credit or can take this class TAKE IT. Also the movies at the end of the semester instead of readings are actually good movies. His commentary on everything makes it 10x more interesting than it already is

he is my goat. he is super nice and funny, the lectures are never boring and he goes out of his way to make them enjoyable. attendance is mandatory but it's always enjoyable to go. there are open note reading quizzes and there are essays, but that's it for grading. goated class
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: There are 4 transcription assignments and 4 scholarly analysis assignment, you are given a week to do them so it's not difficult. There is an in class quiz on canvas every week based on the readings. Attendance is mandatory so make sure to show up. There is a final exam on canvas you can take at home. Overall a good professor and easy A.

Dr. Peterson was very organized throughout the semester and clearly explained what he expected in each assignment. There are three assignments per week, which can be a lot, but they aren't graded harshly and as long as you do most of the assignments, you'll get an A. There are a couple of group projects that are somewhat tedious but still not bad.

I took this professor for ENGL 485 (Arthurian Literature). He's an incredible professor, and if you have a chance to take a directed study with him, please do! He makes sure that you are engaged with the readings, provides great feedback, and is a super caring, nice guy overall!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing man he's cute and funny, great at explaining old English texts. open note quizzes and exams. The entire last half of the semester is watching movies. highly recommend for non English majors

He's a very fun and quirky teacher, he makes lots of jokes in class and you can tell he's very passionate about what he teaches, and tries to make it fun for the class. As long as you keep up with the reading or at least read the cliffnotes before class, you'll do fine on the weekly "surprise" 3 question reading quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very easy class. Lots of discussions/writing assignments every week,but they generally don't take more than an hour or so(besides the major projects). There is an assignment calendar posted from the very beginning that tells you what is due and when. Never seen him, but he grades pretty quick and lenient. Overall, good professor.

It's an easy class to begin with. Dr. Peterson can be an incredibly boring professor, but he knows his stuff and is a very lenient grader. He tends to make a lot of jokes that aren't funny, but he'll laugh and stare at the class until they laugh. He's goofy and awkward, but for 203, he is worth it.

The syllabus clearly defines every assignment and due date at the beginning of the semester. He's quick to respond to emails with questions. Assignments are due every Mon, Wed, Fri and are usually pretty short. About every other week, there's a long writing bit, but you don't need to have strong writing skills to do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Peterson is super sweet and very understanding. I got a bad grade on one of my papers and he let me redo it and the grade went from a 50 to a 90. He wants his students to succeed so if you read the material and go to class, you will easily get an A.

He is such a sweet professor. I received a bad grade on my first paper which made me really nervous to stay in the class. I went to go talk to him during office hours and he let me redo the paper and he would re-grade it completely. He explained what he was looking for in his papers and helped me fix my mistakes. Best professor!

I had him for Linguistics and he was the most understanding professor, so long as you do not take advantage of his leniency. He is always available for office hours and really cares about his students understanding the material he's teaching. Go into his class expecting to learn something new and laugh a little, and you will easily get an A.

Peterson is an absolutely excellent professor, with hilarious yet informative lectures and a genuine passion for teaching and for his students. The exams were worth a huge amount of the grade, but grading was extremely generous with clear expectations established beforehand. Read the book and pay attention to lecture and you'll come out with an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is overall super nice and easy. However, although the class is simple, the professor is extremely petty. If he does not like you, he will grade harshly and do everything he can to make sure you don't pass the class.

Professor Peterson was funny and an enjoyable lecturer. He definitely cares a lot about the topic and is willing to answer any questions students may have. The class would get slow at times but not any slower than any other class I have been in. I felt like he was super reasonable when it came to grading and graded pretty fast.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Peterson was hilarious, his lectures were always a great time. Take his class, read the text, turn your stuff in on time and go to class and you'll get an A. Super nice guy.

I took 330 (Arthurian Literature) with Peterson on a whim, and I'm glad I did. I knew a nominal amount about Arthur before hand, and after taking this class I've come to a much greater understanding and respect.

As for the class and content, he's a good professor who cares, just prepare to read, A LOT!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: 210 relies mainly on a few major projects that you do during the semester. Biggest project is the group paper that you have to write. His grading criteria is very straightforward and deadlines are all defined at the beginning of the semester. You know what's expected of you, and easy enough and enjoyable to put in the effort for his class.

Overall, not a bad course. Your grade heavily depends on your exam scores. I felt extremely underprepared and my grade suffered. There are weekly discussion questions that require your attendance, but other than that attendance is not mandatory.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took technical writing online with Professor Peterson and it was very structured. All the due dates and assignments are given to you at the beginning of the course and there's really no surprises. There are plenty of assignments due regularly so just make sure you are on top of it. Do the work and you will get an A.

A great professor who is passionate both about the material he teaches and the students he teaches. He will always give you feedback if you take the time to reach out to him. He grades fairly leniently on his essays and gives you a good deal of freedom in terms of what to write on. If you must fulfill an English requirement, then do it with him.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This guy was unreasonably tough on some of his essay expectations. This was supposed to be an easy introductory class but he was giving me, a senior, low Bs on my papers because I deviated a tiny bit away from the rubric even if the content was good. He is a fair professor but just make sure you follow the rubric to a T.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really great lecturer with a funny humor. It is obvious he is passionate about the material. It is a lot of reading and writing for a class that is not supposed to be writing intensive. He would sometimes contradict his grading policies in the syllabus, but it did not affect my grade that much. He is understanding if you just talk to him!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment:
I took Dr. Peterson for Engl 313! I really like him and this class.
I had a lot of unfortunate turns that happened to me this semester and he was able to work with me on all of them. 
His class is great, he is great, if you want to read some medieval english and have fun, take this class. Super easy if you try!

Didn't learn much. He grades easy. Seems really knowledgeable, but the entire 75 minute class consists of him calling on us to read off our discussion questions, him saying "yeah so what do y'all think about that," him standing there silent until someone speaks up, and then interrupting whoever is talking like one sentence in. Easy A though..

I definitely recommend Dr. Peterson! He is super nice and makes class as easy as possible. There are only 4 writing projects and very clear criteria for each. The reading for class is not bad and I actually liked some of the pieces assigned. He is a SUPER easy grader too. I enjoyed his class!

Never contacted him personally but his class was very organized. A few easy assignments per week with a few major assignments in between. He sends out weekly announcements to specify what the topics of the week are. Very easy grader. Just do the majority of the assignments and it's an easy A.

I did hardly anything for this class and ended up with a 100 (technically 2005/2000) for the class. It was just a quiz and one assignment every week, plus the midterm and final. He offers two extra credit questions on each exam. Take good lecture notes and you'll be fine.

Take Peterson! Great class, clear expectations, average amount of reading. Such a fun class and he is passionate about what he teaches. Not a hard grader; just follow the rubric expectations and you'll pass. Wish I could have him for every class. You don't really read until short stories and a book and a play but they're interesting!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Class is a breeze. Weekly quizzes that he goes over before you submit, easy assignments every Friday, and 2 tests. Highly recommend.

I love professor Peterson! He gives pop quizzes, but they're weekly so you are somewhat prepared for them and they are usually very easy and straightforward. He gives review questions at the end of each chapter and this is mostly what's on the exams. His exams are also open note so take good notes and you'll pass with no problem!

Although he gives pop quizzes, they are extremely easy and straightforward. In addition, it's clear he's passionate about the subject and loves to make jokes or "nerd out" about what he's talking about. Loved the class content and loved the professor's enthusiasm more.

Peterson rocks! take this class for sure! it was clear how we would be graded, 4 essays and attendance / participation writings. considering this was a literature class, the reading was SUPER light. only 1 whole book! he gives good feedback and answers questions fast. super funny guy, who made class interesting for sure!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Such a fun guy! Super awkward and dorky, but that's what I liked about him. World Lit is in no way fun to learn about but he made 8 am enjoyable. Assigns tons of reading but you can get by without it. Easy grader on essays and lets you correct them if needed. Only problem was that he said his tests were a GPA "booster" and they brought mine down.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Peterson is awesome! He's really laid back and cares about his students. He doesn't grade papers super strictly, He is also very willing to help with writing projects. Make sure you go to class, because he does do random assignments (they're super easy).
Easily the best English class I've taken. Dr. Peterson is funny and always there to help when writing your papers. Only have to write 4 papers the entire semester, all with clear guidlines.

Dr. Peterson is one of the best English profs you could have. Most of the reading you do will be from online sources so you don't have to buy a ton of books and he is very straight-forward with grading. Make sure to ask he if you can read the button poem!

3 papers all semester, not long at all just over topics we discuss in class. The readings he assigns, we discuss in class so you can get away with not reading. You do have to get all 3 book materials though for assigned for papers. No tests other than midterm and final, which were simple. Interesting class and fairly easy. Would recommend him!
